title: Extra pages
text: Extra pages need to be created in each of the available languages, e.g. extra_pages.qmd, extra_pages.de.qmd and extra_pages.es.qmd.

title: About
text:
This is a small demo website for how a Quarto website project and babelquarto can be used to create multilingual teaching materials by writing Quarto markdown files that mix both markdown text and R code.
This demo is setup to use 🇬🇧, 🇩🇪 and 🇪🇸 as example languages.

title: quarto_multiling_teaching_website
text:
This is a Quarto website, made using https://quarto.org/docs/websites.
It also includes Babelquarto for translatable pages.
